objective: Make repeated or recovered high-risk candidate audits idempotent without changing the production evidence, model decision, or candidate/truth/training boundary.

required_exact_bindings: complete audit-version object covering model config, protocol code, label registry, and definitions
strict decision schema and route recomputation
candidate-only, non-mutating, non-truth, non-training, and non-deployment flags
behavior.optional_binding_rule: If candidate_review_status exists, every persisted review binding must also match. A synchronous draft may legitimately have no auxiliary status index, in which case the complete audit receipt remains sufficient.
behavior.miss_behavior: Any missing, changed, malformed, duplicated, tampered, stale, or contradictory field falls back to a fresh production audit.
behavior.response_observability: candidate_class_audit_cache_hit is true only for a fully validated reuse and false after a fresh audit.

validation.full_run_latency_boundary: All nine model/SAM operations were exact cache hits. This is a repeat-path integration result, not unseen-image or cold-start latency.
validation.first_attempt_note: The first integration attempt safely missed because synchronous drafts do not create the optional candidate_review_status index. No receipt was reused. The gate was corrected to validate the optional index only when present, then the exact same acceptance passed.

covered_negative_cases: candidate and source-frame changes through existing endpoint guards

manager_diagnostic.finding: The production Start/Stop launchers already invoke D:/Apps/LabelAgent/.venv/Scripts/python.exe, where psutil 7.2.2 is installed.
manager_diagnostic.system_python_error: Invoking manage_remote.py manually with an unrelated system Python lacks psutil, but this is not the supported user entry point and no system package was installed.

boundaries: This optimization removes duplicate persisted audits; it does not shorten the first audit for a new or changed candidate.
The 5.419 ms result is one exact persisted receipt reuse, not a population latency distribution.
No SAM3 fine-tuning, VLM post-training, model-weight change, formal candidate write, human-truth write, training approval, or OSS write occurred.
